We've been getting a lot of support tickets from users of our IoT device pairing system who say they missed the pairing code the first time and have no way to retrieve it without contacting us. Right now, once a user's initial pairing request is registered, sending the start command again does nothing — they just get silence.

We need to fix this so that any unapproved user can send the start command as many times as they need and always get their pairing code back in response, not just the very first time they request it.

Please make the necessary code change in the OpenClaw installation on this server and apply it so the fix takes effect immediately.
